# ODCS JSON schema fixture

`odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json` is the official Open Data Contract Standard v3.1.0 JSON schema, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard (`schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json`), published under the Apache License 2.0
(Copyright the Bitol / Linux Foundation contributors). It is used only by `tests/export-odcs.test.ts` to validate what `src/export/odcs.ts` writes.
